# src/services

Infrastructure code with no UI of its own: HTTP, storage, secure storage, security, flags, remote config, logger, i18n, linking, toast, network, files, crash reporting, firebase. Each service is a kebab-case folder.

## Layout

```
services/<kebab-name>/
  index.ts                      public API of the service
  <PascalName>.tsx (+ test)     only when the service ships a provider or component
  <camelName>.ts (+ test)
  <kebab-sub>/                  one nested level at most (services/security/pinning/)
```

Two nested levels is a lint error.

## Rules

- Import a service through its alias and barrel: `@services/<name>`. Never import another service's internals.
- All HTTP goes through `request()` from `@services/http` with a Zod schema. Storage goes through `@services/storage`; tokens only through `@services/secure-storage`.
- Read env through `ENV` from `@config/env`, never `process.env` or `react-native-config` directly.
- Log through `@services/logger`: no `console`, no secrets, tokens or PII in log lines.
- Services do not import features or screens. Features and shared code import services, not the reverse.
- Every service has tests. Mock only native modules; network tests use MSW.
- A new runtime dependency needs an ownership entry in `eslint.config.mjs` (`yarn lint:deps`).

## Generators

There is no generator for a service folder. Copy the shape of an existing one (for example `src/services/toast`), keep the barrel, and add the tests in the same commit.

Full rules: `ai/rules/architecture.md`, `ai/rules/api.md`, `ai/rules/state.md`, `ai/rules/security.md`.
